RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex could not have been a factor that disadvantaged you in the selection. An all-female panel selecting one qualified female candidate over another provides no evidence or presumption of unlawful sex discrimination.

Raising the panel's gender composition would appear completely unfounded, undermine your professional credibility, and damage your standing in the civil service.

Instead, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. Focus your inquiry strictly on merit-based criteria—such as how your public policy and legal qualifications were weighted against the successful candidate's international project experience—to gain actionable insights for future promotion opportunities.
